item.description:
Welcome to the blog! Here’s a test of LaTeX math rendering.

Inline Math

The famous mass-energy equivalence: $E = mc^2$

Block Math

The Gaussian integral:

$$ \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2} dx = \sqrt{\pi} $$

Quadratic Formula

$$ x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a} $$
